title: Card Relationship Levels and How the Components of a Personal Checking Relationship Balance Are Put Together
content:
*Question.* What decides the way the components of a Personal Checking relationship balance are put together?

*Answer.* The owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards, read with a premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts and certificate principal held under Certificates of Deposit.

1. Where the owner has made at least 6 card payments in the last twelve months **and** the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00, the deposit, certificate, checking and card components are added together.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner has made at least 3 card payments in the last twelve months **or** the owner's certificate principal is above zero, the deposit, certificate and checking components are added together and the card component is left out.
3. Where neither case applies, the components are not added together in either of those ways.

*Question.* What do the two cases give on the same components?

*Answer.* With a deposit component of 15000.00, a certificate component of 20000.00, a checking component of 2400.00 and a card component of 800.00:

| Owner's position | Relationship balance |
|---|---|
| 7 card payments in the last twelve months, premier money market balance of 9000.00 | 38200.00 |
| 7 card payments, premier money market balance of 900.00 | 37400.00, the card component being left out |
| 1 card payment, certificate principal of 20000.00 | 37400.00 |
| 1 card payment, no certificate principal | Neither case applies |

*Question.* Where does the card component itself come from?

*Answer.* It is the total of the card payments the owner has made in the last twelve months, taken at the card relationship share and rounded half-up to the cent. It enters the figure only under the first case. Equality satisfies each threshold, so exactly 6 card payments with a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches that case.
